opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied, the Court having duly noted the Solicitor General’s concession that the sentence under Count VII of the indictment cannot stand and his undertaking that the Government will duly present to the District Court, under Rule 35 of the Federal Rules of Criminal Procedure, a motion for correction of the sentence.
